meta.title: Stockholm
meta.subtitle: Gamla stan's evening, with example data

details.description: The royal palace: some six hundred rooms round its courtyard, its fronts floodlit after dark.
Stockholm's cathedral, the oldest church in Gamla stan.
The German church, its copper spire over the lanes.
The burial church of Sweden's kings, under its cast-iron spire.
The city hall, its tower carrying the three crowns over Riddarfjärden.
The parliament on Helgeandsholmen: its lit windows follow its offices at work.
Traffic over Centralbron, between Norrmalm and Södermalm.
From Slussen to Djurgården across Saltsjön, all evening.
